prompts.Props: Use case: stylized-concept. Original SHELLSONG premium cosy seaside pixel-art game asset. Beautiful intricate deliberate square pixel clusters, crisp edges, marine navy outlines, turquoise and dusty coral accents, mother-of-pearl cream and lavender highlights, tiny warm gold details. Not smooth vector, not blurry painted realism or 3D, no commercial characters or logos. Asset type: genuinely transparent 2 by 2 sprite atlas, square canvas. Exactly FOUR separate objects each centered in its own quadrant with wide 18 percent transparent padding and a fully empty gap between quadrants. Top-left: OPEN EMPTY pearly abalone clam shell bowl, top/front three-quarter view, wide oval hollow interior clearly visible, iridescent scalloped cream-blue rim and subtle ridges, no pearls. Top-right: EMPTY uncapped squat round transparent blue glass jar, thick rim at top, big clean transparent hollow body and thick blue base, no pearls or contents. Bottom-left: ONE large beautiful round ivory pearl, with subtle cyan/lilac reflections and a tiny gleam. Bottom-right: finished capped round glass jar filled with a few tiny pearls, cork stopper, coral ribbon and small gold star clasp. All objects separately fully visible, generous spacing, no connecting shadows, no text or numbers. Preserve clear transparent background, especially inside the empty glass jar.
